title: Herbed Crunchy Jamaican Fish Ceviche
description: A resinous, crunchy, light Jamaican fish ceviche brimming with citrus, African fermented shrimp sauce, and tempered chocolate nibs for a surprising twist. It’s Whole30-friendly and perfect as a bright snack or starter.

ingredients.name: fresh white fish fillets (cod or snapper)
seaweed aekjeot (fermented shrimp seaweed sauce)
ingredients.notes: use low sodium version if possible

instructions: Dice the fish into 1cm cubes and place in a glass bowl.
Whisk lime juice and zest into a small bowl.
Add seaweed aekjeot, salt, pepper, minced jalapeño, and onion to the fish.
Pour lime mixture over the fish, gently toss to combine.
Let the mixture marinate in the refrigerator for 20 minutes.
While the fish marinates, temper chocolate by heating to 115°F, cooling to 90°F, then chilling until firm.
After marination, stir in chopped cilantro, parsley, thyme, and toasted coconut flakes.
Remove fish from the fridge, line serving plates with parchment, and spread ceviche evenly.
Drop tempered chocolate shards on top of each portion.
Serve immediately with extra lime wedges on the side.
